'''Massachusetts Correctional Institution – Plymouth''' or '''MCI - Plymouth''' is a minimum-security prison facility located in the [[Myles Standish State Forest]] in [[Plymouth, Massachusetts]].  It is not to be confused with much larger [[Plymouth County Correctional Facility]], also located in Plymouth.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.statecourts.org/inmate-search/massachusetts/plymouth-county/massachusetts-correctional-institution-plymouth/|title=Massachusetts Correctional Institution - Plymouth Inmate Records Search, Massachusetts - StateCourts|website=www.statecourts.org}}</ref>
